description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Additional Spells: Inflict Wounds, Ray of Enfeeblement, Vampiric Touch, Blight and Raise Dead are always prepared once you have slots of that level (add them from the compendium). Life Manipulation: when you cast a Necromancy spell with a slot, the module offers to roll up to two of your unspent Hit Point Dice; you regain the total + the slot level and those dice are spent.

system.requirements: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Life Manipulation healing offered by the module after a slot Necromancy spell.
